title: Concept: Mail capture interface published with the app
description: A MailHog web interface page in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The interface shows every message the environment sent, including password resets, statement notifications and any token that was mailed as plain text.
applicability: Deployments that render a MailHog web interface page into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The interface shows every message the environment sent, including password resets, statement notifications and any token that was mailed as plain text.
